composition: Rapperswil peninsula with the castle and parish church above the old town · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Rapperswil Castle stands on the rocky end of the peninsula, a three-towered Schloss and palas above the old-town roofs, with the parish church beside it and Lake Zurich on both sides. The long wooden bridge can cross the water to one side, as the existing lake crossing. Rapperswil is the locality in the municipality of Rapperswil-Jona, canton of St. Gallen, on the upper lake opposite the Zurich shore. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and breezy, and no scaffolding is added.
